reviews.text: Truly passionate professionals, thank you ladies 😃 …

No stress whatsoever, even Olympian calm for my cat Nono, who usually turns into a tiger at the vet! Dr. Bakhtiary's gentleness and exemplary professionalism are truly remarkable! His listening skills, dedication, and availability are outstanding! I highly recommend his services!
A very professional, down-to-earth, and incredibly kind veterinarian. Always attentive, she takes the time needed and gives excellent advice for our pets. I highly recommend her!
I recommend without hesitation, top-notch and attentive vet.
Two veterinarians who have an enormous love for our animals and their owners, it's always a pleasure to visit them, I highly recommend them!
First appointments before the arrival of a puppy in our lives. Dr. Bakhtiary and his secretary are very professional, reassuring, and offer excellent advice. Thank you so much! 🙏 …

My favorite vet, whom I highly recommend for your pets.
Professional, caring, and attentive, she's the best I've found in Lyon!
Excellent veterinarian. Professional, gentle, a true vocation for her: my dog ​​adores her. The clinic is very clean and the staff are lovely.

I wholeheartedly recommend this veterinarian.

My Cavalier King Charles Spaniel had a worrying injury on his paw, which turned out to be a benign tumor. From the very first consultation, the diagnosis was made with great professionalism, gentleness, and genuine concern for my dog's well-being.

Thanks to the perfectly tailored prescriptions, the lesion completely disappeared in just 7 days. I was impressed by the quality of the follow-up, her availability, and the clear explanations she provided for each step of the treatment.

It's incredibly reassuring to be able to entrust your pet to such a competent, compassionate, and dedicated practitioner. A huge thank you for treating my dog ​​with such seriousness and kindness. I highly recommend her.
Super professional and friendly teams, it inspires confidence
An honest vet who takes good care of animals and follows up when there are minor issues. Always available, I highly recommend him.
The best!

Amazing consultation by Dr. Hautier - she was thorough, patient, and most of all, so kind to my pup. The clinic was sparkling clean and consultation rooms were welcoming.

Such a pleasant experience for both my pup and I - would highly recommend this veteraire to any person looking for a vet in Lyon.

Merci, Dr. Hautier and Veterinaire Lyon 6!

Fantastic veterinary clinic! Everyone is attentive and very friendly, and they're also super accommodating with appointments!

I've been bringing my pet here since she was a kitten, and I have nothing but praise for them 👍🏽

Thank you to Dr. Bakhtiary who was able to see my little dog as an emergency between two patients. My dog ​​hadn't eaten for 48 hours. A bone was stuck in his gum.
Very professional and efficient!
I highly recommend him!
Thank you so much for taking care of Moustache and for your kindness.

A clinic with a very warm welcome. Ms. Bakhtiary and her assistant have always given us invaluable advice and found quick appointments in case of emergencies for our little English Cocker Spaniel. A truly local vet who cares deeply about her furry patients. I highly recommend them.
The receptionist said, "Wait, I've answered," and we listened to her talk for three minutes without speaking to us. "You're a professional, just like France today."

It's rare for a beagle, a notorious glutton and determined gourmet, to show such enthusiasm at the approach of a veterinary clinic. Buddy, however, recognizes the way from the very first steps, convinced that beyond the attentive care he receives, what awaits him is that little treat at the end of the consultation (carefully chosen to maintain his figure while satisfying his insatiable appetite).

I would like to warmly thank the entire team, veterinarians and assistant, for their constant kindness, competence, and gentleness. Each visit is marked by genuine attention to Buddy, clear explanations, and a gentleness that transforms the consultation into an almost festive occasion (at least according to our four-legged friend).

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic, where professionalism rhymes with humanity (and with canine indulgence), for the well-being of our companions and the peace of mind of us owners.

Thank you, from Buddy and his human family.
Excellent clinic, I highly recommend them without hesitation. A very competent and lovely vet.

A huge thank you to Dr. Bakhtiary, who treats my dog. Thanks to her professionalism, attentiveness, and responsiveness, she was able to diagnose his illness and save him on several occasions.
You can tell she deeply loves animals and does everything she can for their well-being. Highly competent, she was a true pillar of support during difficult times.
I wholeheartedly recommend this exceptional veterinarian, to whom I owe so much. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for everything you did for Sherek.

The staff were very welcoming, attentive, and highly professional.

I recommend this clinic.

An extremely positive experience at the veterinary clinic! The entire team is attentive, caring, and highly professional. Their advice is always clear, tailored, and of high quality. You truly feel supported, both for the animal and the owner. I highly recommend them!
Great little veterinary clinic.

I have a little bulldog who was treated by the previous vet, and when the practice took over, I stayed with them. She's now 7 years old.

What can I say? My dog ​​has a lot of health problems, and Dr. Bakhtiary and the veterinary assistant, Claire, are absolute angels. They are attentive, available, conscientious, and professional! You can go there with complete confidence.

The doctor is incredible. We were having hot chocolate in a brasserie in Cordeliers when we realized our dog had swallowed rat poison that had been placed under the banquettes. I called the doctor, who saw us immediately. She was gentle and very professional, gave us excellent advice, and took great care of our puppy. She saved his life! A huge thank you.

Once again, we are touched by Ms. Bakhtiary's kindness, gentleness, and competence. She saw us without an appointment, and our little cocker spaniel, Jo, was treated quickly. Our little animals are well cared for and come to this clinic with pleasure—it's immediately apparent!

Thank you to the team. 🐾
Top-notch vet who took excellent care of my cat Baloo
A heartfelt thank you to Caroline & Claire for their professionalism, expertise, gentleness & dedication in taking care of our treasure.
The vet is wonderful, unlike the receptionist and the person who answers the phone. The prices aren't cheap for a cat's sprain (around €200), but it's a good practice.
The vet and team are very friendly and take great care of the animals! It's wonderful to see people who understand the problems and know how to find solutions while being kind...
Excellent veterinarian, very attentive and highly professional. I recommend Dr. Bakhtiary without hesitation!
